statement: For f_n:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1} equal to +1 only at (+1,...,+1), I_i(f_n)=2^{1-n} and [sum_i I_i(f_n) log_2(1/I_i(f_n))]/I(f_n)=n-1 for n>=2. Thus Han's coordinate-influence correction cannot be bounded by a universal multiple of total influence, even within this elementary family.
assumptions: uniform product measure; standard flip influence; n>=2; log base 2
source: own derivation from definitions; comparison theorem: Xiao Han, A New Bound for the Fourier-Entropy-Influence Conjecture, Combinatorica 45:4 (2025), doi:10.1007/s00493-024-00133-z
proof: Coordinate i is pivotal exactly when all n-1 other coordinates equal +1, an event of probability 2^{1-n}. Hence I=n2^{1-n}, and the correction equals n2^{1-n}(n-1).
remaining_gap: This refutes only the proposed bridge from Han's bound; it says nothing against FEI itself. Independent audit pending.
